items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this for a premium documentary YouTube Shorts channel about money, history and the tricks behind them. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller with a hint of mystery: curious, quietly amused, energetic and punchy, never slow, never announcer-like. Natural emphasis on dates and numbers, questions end with a curious lift, a short comic pause before each punchline. Keep the same voice, pace and energy from start to finish.
lines: Narrator
That free stock tip in your WhatsApp group? You might be the exit.
Narrator
Here's how a pump and dump works. First, operators quietly buy a tiny, cheap stock.
Narrator
Then the group lights up. Target five hundred rupees! Screenshots of huge profits.
Narrator
And those happy members? SEBI says many are planted to fake the hype.
Narrator
So you buy. The price jumps. That's exactly when they sell to you.
Narrator
The price crashes. The group goes quiet. Then you're invited to a new one.
Narrator
Sound far-fetched? In twenty twenty-five, SEBI barred fifty-nine people in one YouTube pump-and-dump case and ordered about fifty-eight crore rupees returned.
Narrator
That's the mirage: the group isn't sharing a profit. You are the profit.
Narrator
So before you trust a tip, check the adviser is SEBI-registered.
Narrator
Free tips are never free. Someone bought in before you.
Narrator
This is Money Mirage. Follow for more.
